Bug_Title: DMI: Invocation of hashCode on an array (DMI_INVOKING_HASHCODE_ON_ARRAY)
Bug_Details:
The code invokes hashCode on an array. Calling hashCode on
an array returns the same value as System.identityHashCode, and ignores
the contents and length of the array. If you need a hashCode that
depends on the contents of an array a,
use java.util.Arrays.hashCode(a).

 a java.util.Arrays.hashCode(a)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the hashCode method is called on the array object. This will result in the same value as System.identityHashCode, and will ignore the contents and length of the array. The correct way to get a hashCode that depends on the contents of an array is to use the java.util.Arrays.hashCode(a) method.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by comparing the hashCode of the array to the result of the showBug method. If the hashCode of the array is the same as the result of the showBug method, the test case will fail, indicating that the bug has been triggered.
